document:
Exercise: Chest Push with Run Release

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- sprint
- push

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- medicine_ball

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- enhance_cardiovascular_fitness
- improve_explosive_power
- build_upper_body_strength

Contraindications:

- Recent shoulder or chest surgery
- Severe joint pain or inflammation

Exercise Variations:

- name: Chest Push with Run Release (Single Arm), equipment: medicine ball
- name: Chest Push with Run Release (Medicine Ball to Partner), equipment: medicine ball, partner

Substitution Options:

- name: Push Press with Medicine Ball, equipment: medicine ball

Instructions:

- Begin in an athletic stance with the knees bent, hips back, and back flat. Hold the medicine ball near your legs. This will be your starting position.
- While taking your first step draw the medicine ball into your chest.
- As you take the second step, explosively push the ball forward, immediately sprinting for 10 yards after the release. If you are really fast, you can catch your own pass!
